content: For production multi-memory AI agent architecture research, prioritize deep code inspection of the mem0ai/mem0 repo (61k stars) as the leading candidate, with targeted checks of mem0/configs/ for backend count, mem0/memory/main.py for core memory operation logic, and mem0/utils/ or vector_stores/ for concrete implementations of deduplication, scoring/decay, to confirm it meets requirements of >3 memory backends and implemented scoring/decay/dedup features.
